symbols.name: prime
symbols.meaning: The prime base of the digits of a field.
symbols.quote: Fix a prime $q$ (on this page $q$ is a prime, not a sequence length), and let $b\ge1$ be the number of base-$q$ digits of a field.

symbols.name: digits per field
symbols.meaning: The number of base-q digits of a field.
symbols.quote: Fix a prime $q$ (on this page $q$ is a prime, not a sequence length), and let $b\ge1$ be the number of base-$q$ digits of a field.

symbols.name: field values
symbols.meaning: The number of values a field can take, q^b.
symbols.quote: Put $Q=q^b$, the number of values a field can take, and let $V$ be the array volume, the number of stored data bits.

symbols.name: target value
symbols.meaning: The value of the target field, in [Q].
symbols.quote: The target field has value $y\in[Q]=\{0,\dots,Q-1\}$ and follows a fixed number of control fields.

symbols.name: offset
symbols.meaning: The offset added to the target, prepared from the control values.
symbols.quote: where $a\in[Q]$ is the offset, prepared from the control values.

symbols.name: suffix bits
symbols.meaning: The number of bits following the target field.
symbols.quote: If $B$ bits follow the target, the target and its suffix form $Q$ consecutive blocks of $B$ bits.

symbols.name: multiplier
symbols.meaning: A fixed positive integer prime to q by which the target is multiplied.
symbols.quote: Let $c$ be a fixed positive integer prime to $q$.

symbols.name: piece index
symbols.meaning: The index of the increasing piece of y -> cy mod Q containing y.
symbols.quote: The map $y\mapsto cy \pmod Q$ consists of $c$ increasing pieces, indexed by $j=\lfloor cy/Q\rfloor$.

symbols.name: output coordinate
symbols.meaning: The output coordinate of the target after scaling, running from 0 to Q-1.
symbols.quote: Split the blocks into $c$ streams by $j$, then produce output coordinates $y'=0,\dots,Q-1$ in order, taking each block from the stream $j$ with $y'+jQ\equiv 0\pmod c$, where $y=(y'+jQ)/c$.

symbols.name: denominator
symbols.meaning: The positive integer denominator, prime to q, of a rational unit.
symbols.quote: A rational unit is a signed ratio $c/c'$ of positive integers $c,c'$ both prime to $q$.

symbols.name: array volume
symbols.meaning: The number of stored data bits in the array.
symbols.quote: Put $Q=q^b$, the number of values a field can take, and let $V$ be the array volume, the number of stored data bits.

relations.quote: Each update is carried out by splitting into streams and merging back, as in [Elementary stream operations](stream-ops.md).
